regime_bound: 16 quote days, one quiet 2026 regime, one instrument

slippage_signal_to_fill_pt.n_cap_note: n is capped at 44 by JOURNAL rows carrying a signal_ts, not by fill count; 42 of 44 are matched. Fill rows dropped for a missing timestamp cannot raise this cap (F128).

FORBIDDEN_intended_entry_to_fill_pt.why_excluded: measures the discretionary operator firing late, not execution (charter §3-Phase-0). Shown for contrast; never summed in.

round_trip_cost_pt.composition: entry half-spread + entry slippage + exit half-spread + exit slippage (exit assumed symmetric to entry — UNMEASURED, exits were discretionary)
round_trip_cost_pt.central_is: a MEDIAN-based CONVENTION, not a measurement. Expectancy is E[gross]-E[cost] so the MEAN is the expectancy-correct statistic; at this n the mean's CI is wider than the quantity itself (see slippage.mean_ci95), so the median is used for robustness. It errs CONSERVATIVE — median cost exceeds mean cost — which is the correct direction for a falsifier. Do not quote it as measured.
round_trip_cost_pt.adverse_p90_is: an UPPER BOUND, not a percentile: it pairs the p90 spread with the p90 slippage, and the sum of two p90s is not the p90 of a sum. For an actual percentile use true_round_trip.p90.

true_round_trip.method: 20000 draws, seed 20260813; entry+exit slippage drawn independently from the empirical n=42 distribution, exit symmetric to entry as declared
